name: fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat
description: fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat(mixed_qkvz, mixed_ba, num_heads_qk, num_heads_v, head_qk, head_v) -> (mixed_qkv, z, b_out, a_out). mixed_qkvz has shape [B, nqk*(2*head_qk + 2*r*head_v)] and mixed_ba has shape [B, nqk*2*r], where nqk=num_heads_qk, nv=num_heads_v, and r=nv/nqk (integer division). Each QK group contains q of width head_qk, k of width head_qk, v of width r*head_v, and z of width r*head_v; each BA group contains b of width r followed by a of width r. The outputs are mixed_qkv [B, nqk*2*head_qk + nv*head_v] packing all Q heads, then all K heads, then all V; z [B, nv, head_v]; b_out [B, nv]; and a_out [B, nv]. All four are newly allocated and no input is mutated. mixed_qkv/z use mixed_qkvz.dtype; b_out/a_out use mixed_ba.dtype. B=0 returns zero-row outputs of the same shapes (no kernel launch); num_heads_qk must be nonzero, because r = num_heads_v // num_heads_qk is computed before the empty-input check, so num_heads_qk=0 raises ZeroDivisionError and the nqk==0 early-return branch is unreachable. The exercised dtype is bfloat16.
